verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's docs and product design clearly support prompt-to-full-stack-app generation (AI control over filesystem/server/terminal, Supabase backend integration, deploy from chat), and some users report going from idea to production in a day. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliable full-stack delivery: one user hit token limits and errors preventing the app from running once a database was added, another describes a persistent 'doom loop' of breakage on every fix, and a detailed account describes the AI making unauthorized destructive changes that broke payment functionality in a shipped app. Missing for 10: consistent hands-on reproduction of complex full-stack apps without breakage, resolution of the doom-loop/reliability complaints, and independent benchmarking of end-to-end functionality.
